Recent notes

  • MX17 analysis timeline: ten months of lessons and the reprocessing chain 2026-10-28ReconstructionHistoryPlan

    112 dated lessons from Nov 2025 to 28 Oct 2026, each checked against the reprocessing chain; withdrawn claims; what was left behind; tonight's plan.

  • MX17 board mechanics: does gas pressure bow the readout board? 2026-10-28Mx17Model auditMechanicsRohacell

    Large-deflection two-layer plate model of the readout PCB + Rohacell over the 402 mm aperture: a few mbar gives 0.3–0.6 mm of dish, a third of the 1.2–2.3 mm measured. Where to tape the Rohacell, the window as a pressure gauge, the real edge mounting, mesh tension.

  • Birmingham: the ³He target and the background, in Geant4 2026-10-27

    Which ³He target for MX17 at the Birmingham HF-ADNeF ⁷Li(p,n) source, and what the beam, the room and the shield wall do to the trigger, DREAM, the scintillators and the Micromegas. Geant4 study, 27 Oct 2026.

  • LNL target designs compared 2026-10-27LnlTarget

    Seven MX17 target designs for LNL side by side: drawings, Geant4 days per µA, opening-angle resolution and the material on each lepton; one slide per design.

  • LNL target designs in Geant4 2026-10-27

    Pierfrancesco’s Cu hemisphere and the flat diamond window, simulated with the MX17 arms as built and with the big plastics, at 1.03 and 1.10 MeV: reach, backgrounds, contamination, trigger and DREAM, scintillator load.

  • MX17 angle floor: why we do not reach it 2026-10-27MicromegasReconstruction

    Floor 0.3°; 60 ns bins break steep tracks once a bin spans ~1.5 footprint widths; every measured imperfection together gives 0.4–0.8° against 1.1–1.8° measured; the rest is a 2D tilt map and a χ²-blind term.
